g.text: Channels retain separate isolated grounds. J1/J2 pin 7 reports ISOW EN/FLT through a 10k pull-up; MCU input must not fight an asserted fault.

g.desc: Channels retain separate isolated grounds. J1/J2 pin 7 reports ISOW EN/FLT through a 10k pull-up; MCU input must not fight an asserted fault.

g.text: J3/J4: 1 = bipolar signal, 2 = direct regulated RAW via 0-ohm link (legacy CLEAN name), 3 = isolated ground.

g.desc: J3/J4: 1 = bipolar signal, 2 = direct regulated RAW via 0-ohm link (legacy CLEAN name), 3 = isolated ground.

g.text: IA0305S rails: verify light-load/startup voltage and amplifier output swing. No arbitrary preload or clamp added. Bench use only.

g.desc: IA0305S rails: verify light-load/startup voltage and amplifier output swing. No arbitrary preload or clamp added. Bench use only.

g.text: Resolved: high-impedance DAC input, equal gain resistors, full-reference buffer, EN/FLT pull-ups, added local decoupling, SOIC-8 DAC footprint.

g.desc: Resolved: high-impedance DAC input, equal gain resistors, full-reference buffer, EN/FLT pull-ups, added local decoupling, SOIC-8 DAC footprint.

g.text: NOT FOR FABRICATION. Original input and ordered Howland board were not changed.

g.desc: NOT FOR FABRICATION. Original input and ordered Howland board were not changed.

g.text: Keep output inhibited until rails are valid

g.desc: Keep output inhibited until rails are valid

g.text: and midscale is loaded. Hardware mute is unresolved.

g.desc: and midscale is loaded. Hardware mute is unresolved.

g.text: VREF follows RAW: 3.135 to 3.465 V in steady state.

g.desc: VREF follows RAW: 3.135 to 3.465 V in steady state.

g.text: No hardware output mute or 5 mA limit is implemented here. Validate the ordered Howland interface before energizing outputs.

g.desc: No hardware output mute or 5 mA limit is implemented here. Validate the ordered Howland interface before energizing outputs.

g.text: DRAFT-B: U2/U8 removed; R15/R16 link regulated RAW to the DAC supply/reference. No LDO dropout; VSEL remains grounded.

g.desc: DRAFT-B: U2/U8 removed; R15/R16 link regulated RAW to the DAC supply/reference. No LDO dropout; VSEL remains grounded.

g.text: R3 = R6 and R11 = R12 = 20k nominal.

g.desc: R3 = R6 and R11 = R12 = 20k nominal.

g.text: Source 1% parts retained; validate ratio accuracy.

g.desc: Source 1% parts retained; validate ratio accuracy.

g.text: Added 22uF bulk needs >=10uF effective at bias.

g.desc: Added 22uF bulk needs >=10uF effective at bias.

g.text: New capacitor MPNs remain TBD; draft specs only.

g.desc: New capacitor MPNs remain TBD; draft specs only.
